steps: It turns out we already had the most precious treasure all along.
Let me tweak this a bit...==W== There. Yeah, that should do it, meow!
Freesia! Welcome back! Tough day out there?
Teresa, what's all this? Artifacts everywhere...
Fixing 'em up! Once they're good as new, they'll sell for a fortune! ♪
Sell them? I thought you loved these things.
It's fine! I kept all the useful ones for deliveries. Besides...
Right now, we gotta hit that 1.2 million Dorra mark!
Donna's working her tail off. I've gotta do my part!
Teresa...==W== Heh, you're right. Same here.
But ... cleaning all this up is exhausting, meow. Organizing's never been my thing.
I thought I'd get it sorted before things got busy, but I'm not even close... Should've been pickier from the start.
Don't worry. You never know when one of these might come in handy. And having all these Artifacts is thanks to you, Teresa.
Alright! I'll feel bad about it later. For now, time to fix this pile, meow!
Once these are fixed, we can make more Dorra, the storage room gets cleaned up, and we have space for the bicycle!
Three birds with one stone, meow! Let's do this—!
Yeah! Let's do this together. I'll help however I can.
This mark matches the map... No question about it. The treasure's right here!
What's up, Teresa? Got an answer for me already?
I was wondering ... what are your plans for the treasure?
Cash it in for Dorra, of course! Unless we find a useful Artifact—that we keep for hunting.
Ah, worried about your cut? Don't sweat it. We keep our word.
If it's hard to fence, we'll give you a bigger share next haul. I promise you won't get shortchanged.
B-But this place... It's obviously rigged, right?
Look, the floor drops into a funnel, and there's a single chest sitting in the middle. Textbook trap.
We're at the finish line and you're getting cold feet?! Whatever, step aside and let your boss handle it!
Wait! I'll help you. Just to be safe!
Only the trees on that mountain are shaking. This might not be an earthquake...
That mountain in the direction where the trail pointed! Everyone, move!
Waaah—Help—!!! The floor! It's caving in—!!!
Wait, no! The rope's way too short—!!!
No good. The slope's too steep, and she's still holding the chest... We won't make it!
Quick! Step on my hands! I'll boost you up, meow!
What?! Then what happens to you?!
Hurry! We're out of time, meow!
We... We made it...==W== But where's Teresa?!
Now it's your turn! Get out of there—we've got another treasure to find together!
Thanks for believing in me! It means a lot, meow! But...!
At the end of the day, I'm a Post Haste courier! I can't go treasure hunting with you, meow!
Why?! You said you needed Dorra!
I do want Dorra, but I won't leave my friends behind to get it, meow! My crew means more to me than any treasure!
What an idiot. She didn't have to turn me down flat. She could've cashed out with us first, then gone back to her friends...
Guess that never crossed her mind... Or does she think teaming up with us is some kind of betrayal?
Yeah, makes sense. That stubborn innocence is just who she is.
Fine, have it your way! But if you come crying later, you're not seeing a single Dorra!
Are we seriously doing this right now?! If we don't do something fast, Teresa's gonna...!
Don't sweat it, meow! I've been saving my ultimate move for a pinch like this, meow!==W== Time to show 'em, Gram!
She smashed the ground to rocket herself up?!
I feel a draft! The exit's this way!
That's my rookie! Fall back, everyone—!!
Look out! The whole cave's coming down—==W==whoa, falling rocks?!
Cough, cough! That is a lot of dust!
A landslide... There's something off about this. That earthquake wasn't natural, either.
At Donna's whisper, everyone freezes. Their eyes follow hers to that familiar greatsword.
Teresa has to be okay...! Right, Donna?!
... Yeah. It can't be! Teresa'd never leave us!
Oh—! Donna! Freesia! You found me! And the New Star Guild? What brings you guys out here?
How did you end up in a tree?
Forget that! Get down here first, then tell us!
Teresa recounts her epic treasure hunt to everyone.
Anyway, it was a close call, but we made it. They mumbled something about "opening the treasure where no one can find it" and took off.
... I was going to head straight back to Post Haste, but my stomach was growling...==W== I tried grabbing some tree fruits and walked right into a trap... Hehe.
Don't scare us like that... I was...==W== I was worried out of my mind.
Anyway, I'm glad you're safe. Now I can properly apologize.
I'm so sorry, Teresa! I shouldn't have sold your Artifacts without asking.
No, I should be apologizing! I'm sorry for what I said! And I hadn't cleaned the warehouse at all...==W== I'm sorry.
Honestly, I planned to clean it up, but with all the Artifacts I had to repair, it completely slipped my mind...
Yeah, repaired Artifacts fetch a better price... That way, we'd hit our savings goal much faster.
Savings goal...==W== Wait, you mean the money for the bicycle?!
What else would I be saving for?! The reservation deadline is coming up, so we need to hurry!
I figured I'd gather more Artifacts by joining that treasure hunt, but ...==W== I came back empty-handed, meow. Hehe...
Teresa! You don't have to do it all by yourself! We promised to save up together, remember?
But ... seeing you work so hard, Donna, I had to do something.
But what's the point of saving all that money if you get hurt in the process?!
It's alright. Donna isn't actually mad at you...==W== And neither am I.
... Huh? Teresa, what's that lump under your clothes?
So Teresa's the one who found it!
So this belongs to Lucky Oasis! Good thing I kept it, meow! ♪
You're a lifesaver! Teresa, you're Loxy's hero! The savior of the New Star Guild! The greatest treasure hunter in Nova! ♪
Right? Our Teresa is amazing! ♪ She even found that locomotive parked outside Post Haste!
Don't hug me so tight! It t-tickles, meow!
No need to be shy♪ How about joining us on our adventures? With you around, we'd dig up Artifacts in no time!
Don't you dare poach her—! Without Teresa, we can't recharge our Teresa Energy!
It's the vital nutrients we get from being near Teresa ♪
There's no such magical energy in the world, meow! Right, Freesia?!
It's real?! I had no idea, meow...!
Hehe, she's like a little kitten getting teased. Adorable.
Go ahead and join in, Amber♪
Meow?! Now there's even more of you petting me?!
How long are you gonna keep petting me?!
Huff... Huff... We made it. We should be safe here.
Teresa... Looks like you already found your own priceless treasure. Ah well... Still a shame we couldn't get you to join the crew.
Cap, let's crack this open and see the loot!
Cap, you're telling me that's it? No artifacts? No jewels?
We went through hell for this, and our grand prize is another damn map...? What was all that suffering for...?==W== Heh, hehehehe...
Why are we right back to square one!!!?
